task: PocketSphinx comparison: stock en-us AM vs custom-trained AM (our dataset) vs Whisper fine-tune
test_set: test_data/additional_test_data (171 clips, one new speaker, held out from all training)

models.name: whisper_base_ft_v1 (current best)
models.notes: repetition loops on 40.9% of clips inflate mean WER; median 0

models.name: pocketsphinx_stock_cmd (base/stock AM + 93-phrase JSGF grammar)
models.footprint: ~9.6 MB (6.4 MB AM + 3.2 MB cmudict + 3 KB JSGF)
models.notes: stock en-us acoustic model, grammar-constrained decode

models.name: pocketsphinx_stock_free (base/stock AM + bigram LM, no grammar)
models.notes: free dictation; shows grammar is essential

models.name: pocketsphinx_trained_cmd (custom AM trained on our 6,964 clips + JSGF)
models.footprint: ~1.9 MB (0.97 MB AM + 1.2 KB dict + 770 KB LM)
models.notes: sphinxtrain cd_cont 200-gaussian, converged; 2 clips skipped (align fail)

models.name: pocketsphinx_trained_free (custom AM + bigram LM, no grammar)
models.notes: free dictation with the custom AM

training.toolchain: sphinxtrain (modern task/stage interface), built from source at sphinx_src/install
training.data: 6,964 clean optionb clips (train.jsonl, _clean variants), 16 kHz mono
training.architecture: cd_cont, 200 tied gaussians (split from 1->2->4->8), 37 triphones x 3 states
training.convergence: converged at iteration 7 of stage 8 (ratio 0.077 < threshold)
training.known_issue: 2 training clips failed alignment (ob_COLOR_GREEN_s47_v3, ob_COLOR_RED_s47_v3) and were skipped

analysis.headline: Stock AM + command grammar (78.4%) BEATS the custom-trained AM (74.9%) on the held-out set, at 5x the footprint.
analysis.why: The custom AM overfits the 6,964-clip training distribution: it produces confident wrong phrases (e.g. 'play music' for 'tell me the weather', 'lower' for 'temperature 18 degrees') instead of blanking. The stock AM, trained on ~3000h of general speech, handles the new speaker's pronunciation better. The JSGF grammar does most of the domain adaptation in both cases.
analysis.latency: trained AM is 2.3x faster than stock (26 ms vs 60 ms p50) — smaller model, same grammar.
analysis.recommendation: Ship the STOCK AM + JSGF fallback (9.6 MB, 78.4%, 60 ms). The custom AM (1.9 MB, 74.9%, 26 ms) is a viable ultra-small variant if footprint/latency matter more than the 3.5-point accuracy gap.
